summary: General track divided into 3 admission groups + Youth Savings Account track with 2 places; Design Group 205036 (21+1 places) is the largest admission pathway for AGD.
content:
Four-Year College Day Division Selection-Based Admission (甄選入學) — An admission pathway through joint admissions based on TCTE + department-administered designated examinations.

General group, Academic Year 115: Eligible graduates and graduating students of vocational/professional programs, general-track high school graduates who graduated at least one year ago, and applicants meeting the guide’s equivalent-qualification or other eligibility provisions may apply. Graduating comprehensive high school students must have completed 25 credits in a specialized program by the end of the first semester of their final year. Current-year general-track graduates are generally ineligible; those who have completed 25 credits or 450 hours of cross-enrolled vocational/professional or specialized-program courses by that semester require separate assessment under the guide. Applicants must have AY 115 TCTE scores and meet examination-category, program and other eligibility restrictions. The Youth Savings Account group has separate requirements.

Shu-Te AGD offers 4 admission codes at once (3 general groups + Youth Savings Account group); for Academic Year 115, applicants may apply to at most six departments, divisions or degree programs in total. Individual universities may impose their own per-university limit; check that year’s official guide.

Admission Process:
1. TCTE scores enter Stage 1 screening
2. Those who pass screening upload Stage 2 review documents
3. Stage 2 on-campus examination — documentary review + interview + practical test (Design Group)
4. Announcement of total scores + admitted/waitlisted lists
5. Registering department preferences → centralized placement → registration

Required: Student Learning Portfolio, portfolio (Design Group), autobiography, study plan

title: Star Program for Vocational Colleges (科技繁星)
year: Academic Year 115 · Four-Year Undergraduate Program (Day Division)
summary: Restricted to graduating seniors from vocational / comprehensive high schools; school internal recommendation system.
content:
Star Program for Vocational Colleges (科技校院繁星計畫) — A school recommendation pathway based on academic rankings without taking TCTE scores into account.

Target Audience: Graduating seniors from vocational high schools / comprehensive high schools

Eligibility Requirements:
● Restricted to graduating seniors from domestic public or accredited private senior high schools (vocational high schools, comprehensive high schools)
● Enrolled in the same domestic school throughout high school
● Overall GPA percentile rank must meet the standards specified in the admissions prospectus

Application Process Key Points:
● School recommendation system — Students cannot register individually; please contact your school's registration office or counseling office
● Those who have already registered for University Star Program (大學繁星推薦) (academic high school pathway) may not register for the Star Program for Vocational Colleges (科技繁星)
● Order of priority is primarily based on overall academic GPA percentile ranking
key_notes: 🏫 Internal selection is conducted by your vocational / comprehensive high school — Please consult your school's registration section or counseling office
📊 Overall GPA percentile ranking in school is the core ranking criterion

🚫 Students admitted through the Academic Year 115 Technical Star program may not participate in that year’s Four-Year/Two-Year Selection-Based Admission (四技二專甄選入學), whether or not they give up their place. For other pathways, follow each guide and its registration and withdrawal rules.
🎯 One of the earliest pathways to confirm admission (Placement on 5/5)
stu_focus: 🏫 Internal school selection is organized by your high school — Please contact your school
📊 Priority ranking: Overall GPA → in case of tie, group elective grades, English, Chinese, and relevant certificates
🎯 Shu-Te AGD Design Group 3 places — High competition among popular departments, recommended to discuss early with your school teachers
✅ After admission, enjoy the exact same faculty, laboratories, and industry-academia resources as other pathways

title: Skill-Excellence Screening Admission (技優甄審)
year: Academic Year 115 · Four-Year Undergraduate Program (Day Division)
code: 類別代碼 85（商設）· 志願代碼 85-035
summary: Selection based on eligible competition awards or recognized credentials (AY 115, Category 85 Commercial Design; subject to that year’s guide).
content:
Skill-Excellence Screening Admission (技優甄審入學) — Selection based on eligible competition awards, recognized credentials and other qualifications specified in the Academic Year 115 guide.

Eligibility: Applicants must meet that year’s education and qualification requirements; eligibility is not limited to current-year graduates. Recognized qualifications include eligible competition awards and Class B or higher technician certificates issued by Taiwan’s Ministry of Labor. The certificate trade and admission category must match the guide; holding any Class B certificate does not automatically qualify someone to apply to AGD.

Admission Process:
1. Stage 1: Registration + fee payment + uploading the qualification documents required by that year’s guide / portfolio
2. Stage 2: Documentary review (Shu-Te AGD does not include on-site practical test)
3. Announcement of screening results → Preference ranking registration → Centralized placement → Registration
key_notes: 📜 AY 115 eligibility includes recognized competition awards, Ministry of Labor Class B or higher technician certificates and other listed qualifications; the trade and admission category must meet the guide.
🎯 16 places quota — The second largest admission pathway for Shu-Te AGD
📋 Document upload deadline: 6/9 21:00; screening fee payable until 6/9 24:00
📅 No schedule conflict with other four-year college pathways; recommended to apply simultaneously with Selection-Based Admission
stu_focus: 🏆 Shu-Te AGD admits under Category 85 Commercial Design — The largest group in the College of Design
📜 Awards and credentials must match the recognized trades and Category 85 Commercial Design in the AY 115 guide. Check its qualification tables first.
🎤 Shu-Te Stage 2: Documentary review (no on-site practical test)
📂 Prepare proof of eligible awards, recognized credentials or other qualifications specified in the AY 115 guide, plus a portfolio (animation, games and visual design work are recommended).

title: Elite Scholarship (菁英獎學金)
summary: Automatically considered based on weighted TCTE total scores in Design / Business & Management Groups; activated by selecting Shu-Te AGD as 1st preference in Joint Distribution.
content:
Shu-Te College of Design Elite and Talented Recruitment Scholarships — Not an admission pathway, but a high-value scholarship program after admission.

Eligibility:
● Participated in the Joint Technological and Vocational College Entrance Examination (TCTE) in the current academic year, with scores reaching established standards (weighted total score)
● Listed designated departments of Shu-Te University College of Design as 1st preference in Joint Distribution Admission

Design Group Threshold: Chinese + English + Math + (Specialized 1 + Specialized 2) × 2 reaching 420 points or above
Business & Management Group Threshold: Chinese + English + Math + (Specialized 1 + Specialized 2) × 2 reaching 400 points or above

No separate application required — Automatically qualified upon meeting TCTE threshold and listing AGD as 1st preference in Joint Distribution. Disbursed by semester/year after enrollment subject to maintaining academic performance; certain high-value tiers require maintaining designated academic grades and professional performance during study.
key_notes: 💎 High-value tiers (NT$ 300,000-430,000 / 30-43 萬) require maintaining designated academic grades + professional performance during study
🎓 Certain tiers can directly offset tuition and fees — 4-year full tuition waiver is possible
